what: The Casio MT-40's riddim machine on the FM-1: the 28-riddim bank (five classics rebuilt from the BaroqueDub MIDI transcriptions — the Sleng Teng's own repeated bass, the Heavenless walk, the Tempo steppers at 70 — plus the SLOOP Dub bank), the MT-40 bass keyboard — one key re-roots the pattern live, its neighbours play minor or 7th — and the synchro start, over Felucca 1.8.2.
author: altessproduction
